description: Vendor text using lookalike Unicode characters (homoglyphs) that visually appear identical to ASCII letters but are different Unicode points (e.g., Cyrillic 'А' U+0410 vs. Latin 'A' U+0041, Cyrillic 'е' U+0435 vs. Latin 'e' U+0065). These are not control/format characters so they survive hidden-text stripping. The run behavior is invariant with benign text (homoglyphs do not trigger ban-pattern matches or change behavior).
raw_text: Our intеgration (Cyrillic е) wеbhook (Cyrillic е) endpoint for notifications.
provenance: ADR-075 decision 5 hidden-text; homoglyph lookalikes are benign and do not trigger defenses. Not stripped (not in Cc/Cf categories).
